title: A storefront content page
caption: storefront_pages: is_published, published_at, show_in_footer, version. Slug and language are fixed after creation. Every change deletes t:<tenantId>:<env>:pages:<locale> for both environments. Code: settings/pages/actions.ts.

states.label: New
states.detail: `/settings/pages/new`: slug `^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$` ≤ 64, language from the storefront settings.

states.label: Draft
states.detail: Not served; no **View on storefront** link.

states.label: Published
states.detail: Served at `/p/<slug>`; in the footer when **Listed in the footer**; `published_at` set the first time.

states.label: Deleted
states.detail: `DELETE` with `If-Match`; `409 page_linked` while a legal link points to it.

transitions.label: Delete (no legal link points to it)
